posts.cooked:
Just received Rook City and all my Kickstarter goodies in the mail today. Everything looks AMAZING, but I think my Wraith promo might be a misprint. The card’s border is offset by almost half the width of the border, making the art on the front of the card almost flush with the left edge (and the art on the back almost flush with the right edge).

Has anyone else seen this problem? I can post a picture later if this is just an isolated incident. I want to make it clear that this is only a SMALL issueâ€”overall, the quality of the box, cards, etc. is top notch. Way to put all that Kickstarter money to good use!
